model.name: Traub et al. 2005 channel test cell 2 (Na/K channel subset in one compartment, TestSeg_test2)
model.citation: Traub RD, Contreras D, Cunningham MO, Murray H, LeBeau FEN, Roopun A, Bibbig A, Wilent WB, Higley MJ, Whittington MA (2005). Single-Column Thalamocortical Network Model Exhibiting Gamma Oscillations, Sleep Spindles, and Epileptogenic Bursts. Journal of Neurophysiology 93(4):2194-2232. doi:10.1152/jn.00983.2004
model.license: GPL-2.0 (LICENSE preamble: applies to everything except directories Neuron, Fortran_ifc and Fortran_g77, which carry a cite-on-use condition)
model.expected_behavior: Single segment (d 20 um). k2 0.1, ka 15, ka_ib 15, kdr 62.5, kdr_fs 62.5, km 1.5, naf/naf2/naf_tcr 0.033 each, nap 0.05, napf 15, napf_spinstell 0.05, napf_tcr 0.05, pas 0.3 mS/cm2; no Ca, no Ih. Harness: +0.08 nA 20-80 ms. Shipped reference for the jNeuroML OMV test (.test.soma.mep): 9 spikes 22.8-77.1 ms, ISI 5.8 -> 7.6 ms (fast firing with lengthening intervals). Not simulated in this sweep.
model.inclusion_reason: Tested single-compartment harness with a jNeuroML OMV target; fast adapting firing with M current. Caveats: an artificial channel-comparison cell (notes: "Test cell2"), not a published neuron; GPL-2.0 copyleft; no GitHub check-runs recorded at this commit.
